decision.rationale: The legal rule applies only to operators offering the notice service to the public and explicitly excludes private household use. The customer has confirmed that this deployment is used only for private household purposes and does not offer the notice service to the public. Therefore, the retention duty under this rule does not apply to this system.

findings.summary: The notice record retention and preservation rule is not applicable to this system. The legal duty applies only to operators offering the notice service to the public and explicitly excludes private household use. The customer confirmed this deployment is used solely for private household purposes and does not offer the service to the public, placing it outside the scope of the retention requirement.

summary: This assessment evaluated a notice service implementation against retention requirements for public notice service operators. The system stores notices with their text, receipt timestamps, draft timestamps, and test record flags. The customer confirmed this deployment is used only for private household purposes and does not offer the notice service to the public. Under the applicable legal framework, the retention duty applies only to operators offering the notice service to the public and explicitly excludes private household use. Therefore, the retention rule is not applicable to this system.
